article.title: Cloudinary計劃把商品圖片及影片優化接入CloudFront
article.summary: Cloudinary公布與AWS的整合計劃，目標是從CloudFront控制台啟用圖片及影片優化。
highlights: 公告描述使用Amazon S3存放媒體且已有CloudFront分發的情境。
預計按裝置、瀏覽器及網路等條件調整送出的素材。
article.why: 電商團隊可趁開放前整理常用商品圖片及影片，保留跨裝置比較基準。
article.next_step: 抽選商品頁，先記錄檔案大小、清晰度和載入時間，再問工程團隊可否試用。
article.detail: Cloudinary計劃讓使用Amazon S3存放媒體的團隊，在現有CloudFront分發中啟用其影像優化工具。公司描述會按瀏覽器、網路、裝置及螢幕條件調整圖片和影片。正式開放時間仍待公布。電商團隊可先為素材清晰度及載入速度訂立測試基準。
article.title_en: Cloudinary plans to integrate image and video optimization into CloudFront
article.summary_en: Cloudinary announced a plan with AWS to enable image and video optimization from the CloudFront console.
highlights_en: The announced workflow covers media in Amazon S3 and existing CloudFront distributions.
Delivery is designed to adapt to conditions such as device, browser and network.
article.why_en: Commerce teams can inventory product assets and set a cross-device baseline ahead of availability.
article.next_step_en: Sample product pages, record file size, visual quality and load time, then ask engineering about trial access.
article.detail_en: Cloudinary plans to let teams with media in Amazon S3 turn on its optimization in an existing CloudFront distribution. It describes adapting images and video to browser, network, device and screen conditions. Availability details are pending. Commerce teams can establish baseline tests for visual quality and load times.
